summary: ADRs 0091 and 0092 extract four pure seams plus the tool-drain loop from the 1312-line task service: tool-arguments (canonical order-independent digest), read-result-cache (attempt-keyed reuse), task-capabilities (revision-pinned capability resolution, a security boundary), tool-gate (approval policy), and agent-loop-tools behind an explicit AgentLoopToolContext. The service drops to 1222 lines; provider turns and lifecycle remain.
